overview: The Food Stall Promenade is Shar Vahl’s bustling culinary corridor, filled with clan kitchens and artisan food vendors.
history: Clan cooks established the first food stalls along the lower terraces.
Caravan spices introduced new dishes to the promenade.
Ceremonial kitchens were added to support royal and clan feasts.
During Shar Vahl Reborn, the promenade was expanded with tasting counters.
Market Sentinels began monitoring the promenade for crowd hazards.
hooks: A cooking flare disrupts a tasting event.
A spice vendor reveals a rare caravan ingredient.
A clan cook disputes a stall placement.
A ceremonial dish requires urgent preparation.
